assign.card: Dictation settings: one or two assistants

findings.text: The 360×740 shot the brief asked for "in this folder" is not here: the task folder holds only requirements.md, past-work.md, session.jsonl and review/diff.patch, and the test writes `assistants-360.png` into the older `dictation-debug/settings/shots/` folder (diff `settings.mjs` line 143, `settings.md` Proof line). Copy or write it into `assistant-toggle/` so the work can be judged from here.

Nothing in the task folder says what was built or how it was checked (no report, no test output, no commit hash), so a fresh agent has only the diff to go on; add a short result note listing the commit, the test run and its pass count.

`Mic.js:41` shows "Live now: Servex's default" when the session has no word of its own, because `GET /api/session/<id>` (`Sessions.js:1717`) does not report the boot word. That is honest and within the brief, but the owner still can't see whether the default is one or two assistants unless a boot-word GET is added.

`Mic.js:68` re-sends `gap_ms: null, every: null` with every assistant change when the batch knobs are unset, which resets any knob set directly on the server for that session. Harmless in practice, but a switch that touches only `assistant` would be safer.

`Mic.js:36-52` fetches the live line before any session exists and writes "No session yet", which is clear. `settings.md` and `single-voice-assistant.md` are updated and both link correctly, and the fences were respected (only Mic.js, the test and the two docs changed).

answer.reply: fixed: assistants-360.png is now in this folder (git ignores png here).

fixed: commits 65d3fd77f + 32b1c6587 on worktree/assistant-toggle; node ux/Dictate/test/settings.mjs: all new checks ok (6); the only FAIL, 'join within the delay at 3 s', also fails on unmodified michael/dev, so it is not from this change.
noted: GET /api/session/<id> reports only a per-session word; showing the boot word needs a Servex route, outside the fence.
